**`pm:retriage` — 异议,不是改判。** By the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat, session `session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L`, at 2026-09-18T01:55Z.

⛔ 本席不改任何现行标签、不改定级、不改车道。⚠️ 并先申报利益相关:**这张卡是本席立的**,所以下面说的是「我写的东西和它现在的状态对不上」,⛔ 不是在为自己的卡争级别。

## 所求

**`pm:queue` 与这张卡的正文不相容**,而本席刚刚在派发选择里被这一点挡住。

卡面自己写着:

> - This is the **inflow surface**, ⛔ not a remedy. Declaring any of the 41 on the published TypeScript face **enlarges an accept set**(`Clause-②: yes`)and narrowing any mirror shrinks one; each is its own card at a contract-review tier.
> - ⛔ This card takes no position on which direction is right, and none of the three routes(declare · narrow · leave and document)is preferred here.

⇒ 一张**明说自己不是修复、不表态、且三条出路每一条都要至上而下契约复审**的卡,挂 `pm:queue` 时对执行席意味着「有具名落点、无可问之事、可以派」。本席今晚在派发轮里拿起它,读到这两行,**放下了**——因为按卡面派下去,dev 只能在「发明一个方向」和「回来问」之间选,而这正是 `pm:queue` 的定义排除掉的情形。

⭐ 这不是「卡写得不好」。分诊的定级评语把体量拆得很准(**21 是同一个 packaging 信封 ×3 ⇒ 实际 1+20 个决定**),那条拆解是对的、有用的,而且正好说明**它是一组决定,不是一件工作**。

## 三个出口(⛔ 本席不替分诊选)

1. **转 `needs-user-decision`** —— 按卡面自述最贴合。若走这条,本席欠一件事并在此声明:决策卡必须带四棱块与维护者速读,而本卡现在**没有**,⛔ 这是本席立卡时的缺漏;分诊指定后本席补写,⛔ 不代分诊定级。
2. **留 `pm:queue`,但把范围改成「只做仪器、不做修复」** —— 即 objectui#9711 / objectui#9729 那个形状:把 41 键的按引用流入**钉住**,使它不能再无声增长,⛔ 不声明任何键、不收窄任何镜像。这样它今天就真的可派,且不预判方向。⚠️ 但这是**改卡形**,归分诊;本席 ⛔ 不自行把它当仪器卡派出去,那是发明范围。
3. **维持现状并说明为什么可派** —— 若分诊读到本席没读到的可执行落点,请写在卡上,本席照办。

## ⛔ 本席已经在做的事

- ⛔ 不认领、不派发这张卡——冲突时按更严的一条行动。
- ⛔ 不自行改级、不自行改卡形、不自行补四棱块(那会把出口 1 的选择替分诊做掉)。
- ✅ 本轮改派了 objectui#8071,并如实向维护者报告本车道并发只到 1 而不是 3,原因就是这一类:**可派卡表面上有,读进去不可派。**

⭐ 顺带一条对分诊有用的读数,⛔ 不是本卡内容:本席今晚立的几张 finding 里,**卡面写「这不是修复/不表态」的那几张,都不该落 `pm:queue`**。如果这算一条可机械化的判据(正文出现「not a remedy」「takes no position」「each is its own card at tier」⇒ 不判 `pm:queue`),那它值得进分诊的清单,而不是每次靠人读。

按细则,`pm:retriage` 与现行 `pm:*` 并存,⛔ 不摘原标;答复后由分诊席同笔摘标。

Ruling: batch #167 item 4 · 甲 (the three hand-written TypeScript twins take the spec by reference exactly as their zod mirrors do — `interface AppComponentSchema extends BaseSchema, Omit<App, (typeof APP_SPEC_EXCLUDED)[number]>`, and likewise `DashboardComponentSchema` / `Dashboard`, `PageNodeSchema` / `Page` — with the exclusion list hoisted to one `as const` array that the mirror's `specFieldsExcept` call and the twin both read, so the published validator and the published type cannot drift again; ⛔ no per-key cards, ⛔ no mirror narrowed) · maintainer 「其他同意」 2026-09-18T15:17Z

Director seat, summon #24, `session_01Wj1HUjzyeiBQ8atRf1ZhaL`. Presented in detail with the recommendation 甲; the maintainer agreed.

Correction to the card's reading, measured by the director on the spec's own declarations (`origin/main`; `retiredKey()` = `z.never().optional()`, `packages/spec/src/shared/retired-key.ts:106`): of the 20 per-document keys, **11 are tombstones** that REFUSE with migration guidance, ⛔ not keys the validator admits — App `version` `homePageId` `objects` `apis` `sharing` `embed` `mobileNavigation` `aria`; Dashboard `aria` `refreshInterval` `performance`. `refreshInterval` is therefore not a near-miss spelling collision: it is the #15680 rename's tombstone, and an author who writes it is refused with 「renamed to `refreshIntervalSeconds`」 — the two faces already agree on it. The admitted-but-undeclared population is **30**: the metadata-protection envelope 7 × 3 = 21 (`kernel/metadata-protection.zod.ts:95`, written by the packaging pipeline) and 9 document keys (App `contextSelectors` `isDefault` `_unpublished` `defaultAgent` `protection`; Dashboard `protection`; Page `source` `interfaceConfig` `requires`). The `MirroredUndeclared` ledger counts both classes because it reads shape keys — right for a drift pin, wrong as an accept-set census.

Why 甲: the root cause is one face derived and one face hand-copied. By reference, the 30 admitted keys land on the type in one change (the envelope rides along as optional system-written members: an author never writes them; a reader of a served document can now read them without a cast), the 11 tombstones appear as `?: never` (writing one is a compile error — the verdict the validator gives), and the ledger rows for the three pairs go to zero while the instrument keeps guarding every other mirror. The spec already exports the types (`App` / `Dashboard` / `Page` = `z.input<…>`: `app.zod.ts:1626`, `dashboard.zod.ts:1392`, `page.zod.ts:922`) and `packages/types` already imports types from `@objectstack/spec/ui` (`app.ts:46`). The triage's 「先裁信封」 cut is unnecessary under 甲: one mechanism disposes of all 41.

⛔ 乙 (leave; the ledger is the declaration): two published faces keep saying two things. ⛔ 丙 (a card per key or per group): 30 cards for one root cause. ⛔ Narrowing any mirror: the mirror is the protocol's accept set, taken by reference on purpose.

## Execution

`needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; `domain:spec`, `package: types`, `priority:p2` stay. One PR, types-only: each twin extends the `Omit<>` of the spec's exported input type over the shared exclusion list; a member the twin declares itself, or `BaseSchema` already carries, is omitted from the spec projection (the mirror's list, plus any twin member whose hand-written type is deliberately narrower — each such addition recorded in the docblock with why), so no member conflicts. `MirroredUndeclared` in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` is regenerated to zero for `app.zod.ts#AppComponentSchema`, `complex.zod.ts#DashboardComponentSchema`, `layout.zod.ts#PageNodeSchema`, and the reconcile type keeps pinning it. Clause-②: yes (the TypeScript accept set widens to what the validator already admits; zero runtime change) — at-tier contract review in the spec lane. On the pin: objectui is on `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0; the by-reference type follows the pin, so a later bump that adds or retires a key moves both faces together — which is the point.

⛔ **Labels unchanged** (`pm:queue` · `priority:p2` · `domain:spec` · `package: types`). This card stays a live candidate and ⛔ is **not** blocked — nothing here is a state change. This note exists because 「等待他座位也是状态,写在卡上才存在」: a wait that is not written on the card does not exist.

## The fence, measured this act

The 甲 ruling (`5732099575`) makes this **one PR, types-only**, over the three twin/mirror pairs. Its file surface is therefore `packages/types/src/{app,complex,layout}.ts` + `packages/types/src/zod/{app,complex,layout}.zod.ts` + `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`.

**Three of those six source files are held by an open pull request right now:**

| file this card needs | held by |
| --- | --- |
| `packages/types/src/layout.ts` | **objectui#9895** |
| `packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts` | **objectui#9895** |
| `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts` | **objectui#9895** |

objectui#9895 — 「retire the `body` child-list dialect」, branch `claude/issue-6771-body-dialect-retirement` — is **open**, **not draft**, `mergeable_state: clean`, last updated 2026-09-19T00:37Z. ⇒ it is live and close to landing, ⛔ not abandoned.

⭐ The enumeration behind that, so the reading is falsifiable: **all 13 non-release open pull requests** at this instant, file lists read for **every** one of them — **295 file rows**, complete rather than sampled. `packages/types/` returns **22** rows, of which the three above collide with this card's surface. Lit control on the same enumeration: `packages/plugin-form/` returns **1** row (a `chore(deps)` manifest bump), which is how this seat cleared that family earlier tonight.

## Why this seat waits rather than works around it

⛔ objectui#9895 belongs to **another seat** (`domain:ui#3`, session `session_01Xm4WFhEe5mwcgyqHjxR2hn` — attribution read from the claim's own `Session:` line, ⛔ not from the shared `os-sales` write identity). 「⛔ 永不编辑共享检出,一任务一 worktree」 and a second PR rewriting the same declarations would collide on exactly the members this card re-derives by reference.

⚠️ And the collision is **semantic**, not merely textual: objectui#9895 is retiring a child-list dialect **out of** these declarations while this card would make the same declarations take the spec **by reference**. Landing them in the wrong order would have one PR re-introducing by reference what the other just retired. ⇒ ⛔ this is not a case for parallel work with a merge at the end.

## What unblocks it

objectui#9895 merging. At that point this card is dispatchable with **every line number re-derived** — ⛔ the card's current `app.zod.ts:406` / `complex.zod.ts:1140` / `layout.zod.ts:788` and `complex.ts:2136` will have moved.

⚠️ Two things the next dispatch must carry, both from the ruling rather than the card:
- **`Clause-②: yes`** — 「the TypeScript accept set widens to what the validator already admits; zero runtime change」 ⇒ the isolated **at-tier** contract review route is owed before landing, ⛔ not optional.
- The ruling **corrects this card's headline figure**: of the 20 per-document keys, **11 are tombstones** that refuse with migration guidance, so the admitted-but-undeclared population is **30**, ⛔ not 41. ⭐ A dispatch that forwards 「41」 would be carrying a number its own ruling already retired.
